name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless® Credit Card

tripDelay.notes: Eligible for delays of 12+ hours or requiring an overnight stay. Maximum $500 per ticket.

tripCancellation.notes: Covers non-refundable prepaid trip expenses. Maximum $10,000 per covered trip, $20,000 per account per 12 months.

lostBaggage.notes: Covers lost, damaged, or stolen baggage. High-risk items (electronics, jewelry) capped at $500.

baggageDelay.notes: $100 per day for up to 5 days when baggage is delayed 6+ hours.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available 24/7 to help arrange emergency medical referrals, evacuation coordination, and legal referrals. Actual costs of services are the cardholder's responsibility.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Decline the rental company's CDW to activate. Coverage for up to 31 consecutive days.

airlineCredit.notes: 2026 exclusive: Earn up to $100 in statement credits on eligible airline purchases ($50 after $250 spend in each half-year: Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec). This is an ongoing offer subject to change.

rewards.travelRate: 6x on purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy
rewards.diningRate: 3x on first $6,000/year in combined grocery stores, gas stations, and dining

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.7–1.2¢ per point typically; best redeemed for Marriott hotel stays (aim for 0.8¢+)

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Visit the Visa Signature benefits portal or call the number on back of card

travelPerks: Annual Free Night Award (up to 35,000 points) every account anniversary
Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite status each calendar year
15 Elite Night Credits annually toward higher status tiers
Path to Gold Elite status after $35,000 in annual purchases
Up to $100 in annual airline statement credits (semi-annual)
Secondary rental car collision coverage (up to $75,000)
$100 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Baggage delay coverage ($100/day, up to 5 days)
bestFor: Marriott loyalists who want to earn points faster on everyday purchases, receive an annual free night, and enjoy automatic elite status — all for a reasonable $95 annual fee
